ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on: has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on:.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   B. Use Environment School cleanliness to insult classmates of other faiths.

   C. Use Islamic etiquettes to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic etiquettes.
